basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: I am a first-year PhD candidate at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), supervised by Professor Junxian He. My research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with a particular interest in the training and evaluation of large language models (LLMs).

work.name: MINIMAX
work.summary: Working on large language model (LLM) alignment and safety, including pre-training and instruction tuning.

work.name: Tencent WXG
work.summary: Research intern at Tencent's WeChat division, working on large-scale pre-training and model compression.

work.name: Shanghai AI Lab
work.summary: Research intern at Shanghai AI Lab, working on multi-modal understanding and large-scale model training.
